segments.ja389:1.3: Tenābhibhūto kapaṇaṃ rudāmi, hare sakhā kissa nu maṃ jahāsi.
segments.ja389:2.1: So passasanto mahatā phaṇena, bhujaṅgamo kakkaṭamajjhapatto;
segments.ja389:2.3: Sakhā sakhāraṃ paritāyamāno, bhujaṅgamaṃ kakkaṭako gahesi.
segments.ja389:3.1: Na vāyasaṃ no pana kaṇhasappaṃ, ghāsatthiko kakkaṭako adeyya;
segments.ja389:3.3: Pucchāmi taṃ āyatacakkhunetta, atha kissa hetumha ubho gahītā.
segments.ja389:4.1: Ayaṃ puriso mama atthakāmo, yo maṃ gahetvāna dakāya neti;
segments.ja389:4.3: Tasmiṃ mate dukkhamanappakaṃ me, ahañca eso ca ubho na homa.
segments.ja389:5.1: Mamañca disvāna pavaddhakāyaṃ, sabbo jano hiṃsitumeva micche;
segments.ja389:5.3: Sāduñca thūlañca muduñca maṃsaṃ, kākāpi maṃ disvāna [disva (sī. pī.)] viheṭhayeyyuṃ.
segments.ja389:6.1: Sacetassa hetumha ubho gahītā, uṭṭhātu poso visamāvamāmi [visamācamāmi (sī. pī. ka.)];
segments.ja389:6.3: Mamañca kākañca pamuñca khippaṃ, pure visaṃ gāḷhamupeti maccaṃ.
segments.ja389:7.1: Sappaṃ pamokkhāmi na tāva kākaṃ, paṭibandhako [paṭibaddhako (sī. pī.)] hohiti [hoti hi (syā.)] tāva kāko;
segments.ja389:7.3: Purisañca disvāna sukhiṃ arogaṃ, kākaṃ pamokkhāmi yatheva sappaṃ.
segments.ja389:8.1: Kāko tadā devadatto ahosi, māro pana kaṇhasappo ahosi;
segments.ja389:8.3: Ānandabhaddo kakkaṭako ahosi, ahaṃ tadā brāhmaṇo homi satthāti [tatthāti (sī. pī.)].
